messages:
incident-bot: Pager - P2: Elevated runtime latency and queue growth in us-east-1 serving pool. Alerts: 95th latency > 1.2s, in-flight > 240, queue length rising. Paging SRE rotation.
Asha Patel: I'm on it, grabbing logs and recent deploys.
Tom Wu: saw a spike ~10:21 UTC, looks like a batch job hit and caused head-of-line blocking, some model variants went into degraded mode.
Asha Patel: bringing up console... can we temporarily rate-limit tail traffic to reduce new inflight requests? Suggest edge token rate limit 25 rps per key for 5m.
Priya Nair: +1 to rate-limiting. Also propose reducing max_in_flight on runtime from 16 -> 8 for the affected pool to hasten shedding.
Riley: note: lowering max_in_flight will increase client timeouts if they retry immediately. Might need to increase upstream timeout to 10s.
Kenji: I'll patch routing rule to favor smaller 7B model variants (faster) and disable streaming for non-interactive endpoints.
Asha Patel: executing mitigation steps: 1) apply rate-limit at edge, 2) update runtime max_in_flight, 3) disable long-poll streaming flag. Will call commands now.
Asha Patel: `curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/edges/ratelimit -d '{"rule":"token","limit":25,"duration_s":1}'` -> 202 accepted
incident-bot: Deploy bot: Edge config change queued by Asha Patel - change id cfg-8821
Tom Wu: Doing runtime change via infra API: `PATCH /runtime/pools/us-east-1` payload: `max_in_flight: 16 -> 8, shedding_threshold: 0.85`.
Priya Nair: I'm toggling hz-based shedding: set `rejection_policy: probabilistic` to start shedding ~15% above capacity.
Riley: Notifying CS — customer impact likely degraded for large completion requests; embeddings should be fine.
cs-bot: Posting customer banner draft to #customer-updates: "We are mitigating an infrastructure incident affecting generation latency in our US-East region. Mitigations in progress." Should we post now?
Kenji: Hold on posting until we've stabilized. Post in 10 min if 95th < 800ms.
Asha Patel: Runtime patch applied -> runtime-op-id 5542, max_in_flight now 8. Queue length dropped 40% in 60s.
Tom Wu: Edge rate-limit is active. We see throughput drop from 2k->1.1k rps, error rate steady at 0.6%.
Priya Nair: Latency 95th trending down to 720ms, still seeing occasional spikes when larger requests hit.
Riley: I'll open a targeted quota bump for our largest enterprise customers to avoid failed requests: create temporary tenant-level quota increase for customer ids: CUST-42, CUST-77.
Asha Patel: Created quota-exceptions ticket QE-1022, applied +2x burst quota for those tenants for next 20m.
Tom Wu: Observability: traces show KV-cache misses for a subset of models, that increases token compute. Moving some heavy models to lower priority pool.
Kenji: Disabled feature flag `long_running_streams` for affected pool. That should reduce connection hold time.
incident-bot: Alert: 95th latency now 580ms, queue length steady. Auto-escalation suspended.
Priya Nair: Good. Start preparing rollback plan: edge rate-limit to be lifted gradually: 25 -> 50 -> 100 over 10m, runtime max_in_flight back to 16 once stabilized for 5m.
Asha Patel: Agreed. Doing first bump to 50 rps.
Riley: CS banner ready. Posting now to #customer-updates.
cs-bot: Posted banner with runbook link. Comments: customers asked for ETA; we said 30-45m for full restoration.
Kenji: I'll stay on for handoff. Next oncall Tom, any notes?
Tom Wu: I'm taking steady-state monitoring, will keep an eye on error rates and latency. If 95th < 500ms for 15m, we'll revert limits.
Asha Patel: Handoff to Tom. My runbook notes: QE-1022 applied, cfg-8821 edge rule, runtime-op-id 5542, disabled flag long_running_streams. Follow rollback steps.
Tom Wu: Acknowledged. Thanks Asha. Good run.
Priya Nair: Leaving channel, ping if anything flares.
incident-bot: Handoff recorded: from Asha Patel -> Tom Wu at 2112345805.
